G2729907.description: Longyearbyen (Urban East Norwegian: [ˈlɔ̀ŋjɛrˌbyːən], locally [ˈlɔ̀ŋjɑrˌbyːən], 'Longyear town') is one of the world's northernmost settlements, with an estimated population of around 2,400–2,800, and is the capital and largest settled area of Svalbard.

G7535941.description: Olonkinbyen (Norwegian pronunciation: [ˈuːlɔŋkɪnˌbyːən], lit. The Olonkin Town) is the only settlement on the Norwegian island of Jan Mayen (aside from isolated cottage huts such as Puppebu).
